pdfDescription.message: Optional Orateur companion: listen to text-based PDFs with a local voice.

menuReadPdfTitle.message: Read this PDF with Orateur PDF

pdfPrivacy.message: Your document and its speech are processed on this device.

pdfChooseFile.message: Choose a PDF on this device

pdfError_protected.message: This PDF is protected. Open an accessible copy without a password or copying restriction.

pdfError_no_text.message: This PDF has no text layer. Scanned documents need OCR, which is not available here.

pdfError_download.message: This PDF could not be loaded. Check your connection and access to the document, or choose a copy on this device.

pdfError_too_large.message: This PDF exceeds the reader’s limits: 50 MiB, 2,000 pages or 5 million characters. Choose a smaller document.

pdfError_invalid.message: This file is not a valid PDF or its text cannot be extracted. Choose another PDF.

pdfError_file_access.message: Access to this file is blocked. In Chrome, allow access to file URLs in the extension’s details, or use “Choose a PDF on this device”.

pdfModelNote.message: Supertonic downloads about 400 MB of models on first playback, then runs locally. This companion has its own cache.

pdfNoLocalVoice.message: No local system voice is available. Install a voice in your device’s settings or choose Supertonic.

pdfVoiceLanguage.message: Supertonic does not support this language. Choose a local system voice.

pdfSpeechError.message: Playback could not start. Try again or choose another local voice.

pdfEmpty.message: Open a PDF in your browser, then click the Orateur PDF icon. You can also choose a file here. Text-based PDFs only, up to 50 MiB; no OCR.
